independent_work_bound.derivation: Distance norm is 1-Lipschitz, so rmax-rmin <= 2*radius <= 2 metres. With margin m=32*ulp(max(1,rmax)) <= 2^-43 metres, W <= (2+2m)/300 seconds. After k midpoint evaluations, |G| <= 1.25*W/2^k in exact arithmetic for a covered evaluable bracket.
independent_work_bound.finite_arithmetic_limit: Analytic contraction does not replace actual residual checks; the implementation rejects unavailable history/numerical failure and publishes a cached evaluated result without a further evaluation.
